name: Kiraboshi Runa
source:
"Alright, one step closer to my debut! [b]I'm excited![/b]"

[url=/c138331]Yuzuru[/url]'s classmate, a [b][i]gyaru[/i][/b] who is at the top of the school caste. She has gained popularity as a model, affiliated with an agency found by her sister. Extremely cheerful and unafraid of anything, "[b]if she talks to someone at least once, then they are already friends[/b]." Addicted to virtual Performers, she wants to be one herself, but does not know how, nor does she have the equipment to do so. However, after accidentally finding out Yuzuru's identity as Yuzuriha Gakuto, she begins to learn from him, aiming to make her debut.

Tall and stylish, even though she has the look of a model, she does have a complexity. That is, she likes adorable things, and wants to become adorable herself.
